video.title: AI欧腐《龙主的新娘是只橘猫/Sent as a Cat Bride, Claimed by the Dragon Lord》
video.desc:
New York student Leo is transported into a fantasy novel as a chubby orange cat, then offered as a humiliating substitute bride to feared dragon lord Aurelius. An accident binds their lives through a shared star pact. Using his knowledge of the original story, Leo exposes a false saint, clears Aurelius’s name, and uncovers his own identity as the world’s stolen star vessel. When a reborn enemy unleashes an apocalyptic abyss, cat and dragon risk everything to save the realm—and finally claim each other as mate.
纽约学生Leo意外穿进一本奇幻小说里，竟变成了一只胖乎乎的橘猫，还被当成羞辱性的替嫁新娘，献给令人畏惧的龙主Aurelius。
一场意外让两人通过星契绑定了生命。凭借自己对原剧情的了解，Leo揭穿了假圣人的真面目，为Aurelius洗清冤屈，也发现了自己的真实身份——他竟是这个世界被夺走的星之容器。
当重生的敌人释放出足以毁灭世界的深渊灾厄时，猫咪与龙主决定赌上一切拯救王国。最终，他们也真正认定了彼此，成为命定的伴侣。
